* **Data Normalization/Scaling:**

  • Evaluate its effect on model performance and interpretability
* **Handling Imbalanced Data:**
  • Assess the impact of class imbalance on model performance
  • Consider techniques to address class imbalance (e.g., oversampling, undersampling)
